title: Housing Plus
description: A simple homes mod where you can share your homes with the world!
body:
**This mod adds different commands to create, delete, share and access homes.**

|Commands|Function|Aliases|
|:------:|:------:|:-----:|
|```/createhome <name>```|create a home at your current position|```/ch <name>```|
|```/home <name>```|teleport to your home|```/h <name>```|
|```/deletehome <name>```|delete a home|```/dh <name>```|
|```/share <name>```|broadcast a clickable [Teleport] link to all players for them to teleport to your home|❌|
|```/send <target> <name>```|send a clickable [Accept] link to another player for them to add your home to theirs|❌|
|```/spawn```|teleport to the global spawn|❌|
|```/tphome <player> <name>```|admin: teleport to another player's home|❌|
|```/gethome <player> <name>```|admin: copy another player's home to yourself|❌|
|```/setspawn```|admin: set the global spawn point|```/ss```|
|```/setnumberofhomes <number>```|admin: set max homes per player (default 5)|❌|
